function.name: get_values
function.description: Latest available official figures for a US statistical series. Returns, for each period from start_period to end_period: the value, the change from the prior period, the percent change from the prior month (monthly series) or the annualized growth rate (GDPC1), and the percent change from a year earlier.

start_period.description: First period: YYYY-MM for monthly series, YYYYQn for GDPC1.

end_period.description: Last period, same format. Omit for a single period.
